blocks.en: Understand the core purpose and basic principles of Aseptic Process Simulation (APS)

blocks.en: Understand the frequency and number of APS runs, and regulatory expectations for initial and periodic requalification

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Section Contents
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 3.0 Aseptic Process Simulation Concepts and Principles 3.0 無菌製程模擬的概念與原則
blocks.en: 3.0 Aseptic Process Simulation Concepts and Principles

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Aseptic Process Simulation, APS (無菌製程模擬)：又稱為 Media Fill，是無菌製程確效 (Validation) 中最核心的一環。其基本邏輯是：用微生物培養基取代實際產品，經過與正式生產完全相同的操作流程，再將充填好的培養基進行培養。若培養後無微生物生長，便可佐證該無菌製程具備足夠的無菌保證能力。
blocks.en: Aseptic Process Simulation (APS): Also known as media fill, it is the most central element of aseptic process validation. The basic logic is to replace the actual product with microbiological growth medium, take it through exactly the same operations as routine production, and then incubate the filled medium. If no microbial growth appears after incubation, this supports the conclusion that the aseptic process provides adequate sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: Contamination Control Strategy, CCS (污染控制策略)：TR22 特別強調 CCS 必須在執行 APS「之前」就已建立並實施。這代表 APS 不是從零開始驗證無菌能力，而是驗證一套已完整規劃的污染控制體系是否有效運作。
blocks.en: Contamination Control Strategy (CCS): TR22 specifically emphasizes that the CCS must be established and implemented "before" APS is performed. This means APS does not validate aseptic capability from scratch; it verifies that a fully planned contamination control system works effectively.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你是一家手術室的管理者，想驗證手術室的無菌環境是否合格。你不會直接讓病人進來做手術來「測試」，而是先用培養皿模擬手術過程中的所有接觸，然後把培養皿送去培養。如果培養皿上長出細菌，就代表手術室的無菌控制有問題 — 這正是 APS 的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: Imagine you manage an operating room and want to verify that its aseptic environment is acceptable. You would not bring in a patient for surgery to "test" it. Instead, you would use culture plates to simulate every contact that occurs during surgery, and then incubate the plates. If bacteria grow on the plates, the operating room's aseptic controls have a problem. This is exactly the core logic of APS.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: APS 的價值在於它是一個「整合性測試」，一次性檢驗了設備、環境、人員操作、物料傳遞等所有環節。單獨的環境監測或設備確認只能驗證局部，但 APS 將所有要素串聯起來，驗證整體系統的無菌保證能力。
blocks.en: The value of APS is that it is an "integrated test" that challenges equipment, environment, personnel operations, material transfer and every other element at once. Environmental monitoring or equipment qualification alone verifies only one part, whereas APS links all the elements together and verifies the sterility assurance capability of the whole system.

blocks.zh: 對於粉末充填 (Powder Filling) 製程，因為培養基無法以粉末形式充填，必須使用 Surrogate/Placebo（替代物）。這時需要額外評估替代物是否能真正代表實際製程的風險暴露。
blocks.en: For powder filling processes, growth medium cannot be filled as a powder, so a surrogate/placebo must be used. In that case, you need to additionally evaluate whether the surrogate truly represents the risk exposure of the actual process.

blocks.zh: 3.1 Prerequisites 3.1 先決條件
blocks.en: 3.1 Prerequisites

blocks.zh: Prerequisites (先決條件)：APS 不是驗證活動的「起點」，而是接近「終點」的整合測試。在執行 APS 之前，必須確認所有基礎建設都已到位 — 設備已確認合格、HVAC 系統已驗證、滅菌製程已確效、人員已通過培訓與穿衣認證。
blocks.en: Prerequisites: APS is not the "starting point" of validation activities; it is an integrated test close to the "end point". Before performing APS, you must confirm that all foundations are in place: equipment is qualified, the HVAC system is validated, sterilization processes are validated, and personnel have completed training and gowning qualification.

blocks.zh: Engineering Batches / Water Trials (工程批次/水試運轉)：在正式 APS 之前，先用水或其他非微生物媒介進行試運轉，目的是發現機械操作問題、確認介入操作 (Interventions) 的類型與頻率。這一步可以避免在正式 APS 時因機械故障而導致無謂的失敗。
blocks.en: Engineering Batches / Water Trials: Before the formal APS, trial runs are performed with water or other non-microbiological media, in order to find mechanical problems and confirm the types and frequency of interventions. This step avoids needless failures of the formal APS caused by mechanical breakdowns.

blocks.zh: APS 就像是一場正式的舞台演出。你不會在演員還沒排練、燈光還沒調好、舞台還沒搭完的時候就開演。Engineering Batches 就是「彩排」— 先確認所有技術環節都沒問題，才進入正式演出 (APS)。如果彩排時發現麥克風有雜音，你可以先修好再演出；但如果直接開演才發現問題，代價就大得多了。
blocks.en: APS is like a formal stage performance. You would not start the show before the actors have rehearsed, the lighting is adjusted and the stage is built. Engineering batches are the "dress rehearsal": you first confirm that every technical element works before going into the real performance (APS). If a microphone is noisy during the rehearsal, you can fix it before the show; but if you only discover the problem after the show has started, the cost is far higher.

blocks.zh: 這份先決條件清單實際上是一個「確效成熟度檢核表」(Validation Readiness Checklist)。在法規稽查時，查核員經常會檢視 APS 執行的時間點，確認是否在所有先決條件完成之後才進行。如果在 HVAC 確效尚未完成就執行了 APS，即使結果合格也可能被質疑其效力。
blocks.en: This list of prerequisites is in effect a "Validation Readiness Checklist". During regulatory inspections, inspectors often examine the timing of APS execution to confirm that it took place only after all prerequisites were complete. If APS was performed before HVAC validation was finished, its validity may be questioned even if the results were acceptable.

blocks.zh: 設備確認 (IQ/OQ/PQ) 必須完成
blocks.en: Equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) must be completed

blocks.zh: 滅菌製程 (如高壓蒸氣、VHP) 必須已確效
blocks.en: Sterilization processes (such as autoclave, VHP) must be validated

blocks.zh: 環境監測 (EM) 計畫必須已建立並運行
blocks.en: The environmental monitoring (EM) program must be established and operating

blocks.zh: 所有相關 SOP 必須已就緒且人員已受訓
blocks.en: All relevant SOPs must be in place and personnel trained

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 情境中，當客戶要求啟動新產品的無菌充填時，專案經理必須確認所有先決條件是否到位。常見的延遲原因包括：HVAC 再確認逾期、人員穿衣認證過期、新設備的 PQ 尚未完成等。建議建立一份標準化的「APS Readiness Checklist」，在每次 APS 前逐項確認，避免因疏忽而導致 APS 無效。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, when a client requests the start of aseptic filling for a new product, the project manager must confirm that all prerequisites are in place. Common causes of delay include overdue HVAC requalification, expired personnel gowning qualification, and incomplete PQ of new equipment. It is advisable to establish a standardized "APS Readiness Checklist" and check it item by item before every APS, so that oversights do not invalidate the APS.

blocks.zh: 3.2 Number and Frequency of Simulations 3.2 模擬次數與頻率
blocks.en: 3.2 Number and Frequency of Simulations

blocks.zh: 初始確認 — 至少連續 3 批成功 APS：這是法規的基本期望。「連續」(consecutive) 是關鍵字 — 如果第 2 批失敗，計數必須重新開始。實務上，部分複雜製程可能需要超過 3 批來涵蓋所有變數組合。
blocks.en: Initial qualification: at least 3 consecutive successful APS runs. This is the basic regulatory expectation. "Consecutive" is the keyword: if the second run fails, the count must start over. In practice, some complex processes may need more than 3 runs to cover all combinations of variables.

blocks.zh: 定期再確認 — 每半年一次：每條充填線、每個無菌製程、每個班次都必須每半年執行一次 APS。同時，每位操作員每年至少須參與一次成功的 APS。
blocks.en: Periodic requalification: every six months. Every filling line, every aseptic process and every shift must perform APS once every six months. In addition, every operator must take part in at least one successful APS per year.

blocks.zh: Bracketing & Matrix (括弧法與矩陣法)：當同一條充填線生產多種容器規格時，可以利用風險評估選擇代表性的極端條件進行 APS，而非逐一對每種規格都做。但前提是製程等效且容器密封配置相同。
blocks.en: Bracketing & Matrix: When the same filling line produces multiple container formats, a risk assessment can be used to select representative extreme conditions for APS, rather than performing APS for every format. The prerequisite is that the processes are equivalent and the container closure configuration is the same.

blocks.zh: 把 APS 的頻率想像成汽車的定期保養。新車交車時要做全面檢查 (Initial APS = 連續 3 批)，之後每半年做一次例行保養 (Periodic APS = 每半年)。每位駕駛都必須每年至少通過一次路考 (Operator Qualification)。如果你改裝了引擎或換了輪胎 (重大變更)，就需要額外做檢查。而 Bracketing 就像測試最大和最小的輪胎尺寸，如果兩個極端都合格，中間的尺寸通常也沒問題。
blocks.en: Think of APS frequency as regular servicing of a car. A new car gets a full inspection on delivery (initial APS = 3 consecutive runs), then routine servicing every six months (periodic APS = every six months). Every driver must pass a road test at least once a year (operator qualification). If you modify the engine or change the tires (a major change), additional checks are needed. Bracketing is like testing the largest and smallest tire sizes: if both extremes pass, the sizes in between are usually fine too.

blocks.zh: 特殊時機的 APS 考量：TR22 特別提到幾個容易被忽略的時機：
blocks.en: APS considerations at special times: TR22 specifically mentions several occasions that are easily overlooked:

blocks.zh: 停機前最後一批之後：在設備長期停用前做 APS，留下「最後狀態」的紀錄
blocks.en: After the last batch before shutdown: performing APS before long-term equipment shutdown leaves a record of the "final state"

blocks.zh: 長期閒置前/後：確認設備在閒置期間未發生變化
blocks.en: Before/after long idle periods: confirm that the equipment did not change during the idle period

blocks.zh: 產線拆遷或搬遷前：記錄搬遷前的基準狀態
blocks.en: Before a line is dismantled or relocated: document the baseline state before relocation

blocks.zh: 屏障系統的彈性：對於 Isolator 等提供強健隔離的屏障系統，APS 設計（如持續時間）可適度調整，但基本原則不變。這反映了法規對「基於風險的靈活性」的認可。
blocks.en: Flexibility for barrier systems: For barrier systems that provide robust separation, such as isolators, the APS design (for example, duration) can be adjusted to a reasonable extent, but the basic principles remain unchanged. This reflects regulatory recognition of "risk-based flexibility".

blocks.zh: 頻率計算範例 Frequency Calculation
blocks.en: Frequency Calculation

blocks.zh:
假設：1 條充填線，2 個班次，1 個無菌製程
最低年度 APS 次數 = 2 次/年 x 1 線 x 2 班 = 4 次/年

假設：2 條充填線，3 個班次，各有 1 個製程
最低年度 APS 次數 = 2 次/年 x 2 線 x 3 班 = 12 次/年

注意：每位操作員每年至少參與 1 次成功 APS
若有 20 位操作員，需確保排班覆蓋所有人員
blocks.en:
Assumption: 1 filling line, 2 shifts, 1 aseptic process
Minimum annual APS runs = 2 runs/year × 1 line × 2 shifts = 4 runs/year

Assumption: 2 filling lines, 3 shifts, 1 process each
Minimum annual APS runs = 2 runs/year × 2 lines × 3 shifts = 12 runs/year

Note: every operator must take part in at least 1 successful APS per year
If there are 20 operators, make sure the scheduling covers all personnel

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某工廠有 2 條充填線、3 個班次，計畫進行年度 APS。若其中一條線在第 2 批 APS 失敗，接下來應如何處理？重新開始計數的範圍是什麼？
blocks.en: A site has 2 filling lines and 3 shifts and plans its annual APS. If one line fails the second APS run, how should this be handled? What is the scope of restarting the count?

blocks.zh: 一條充填線生產 2 mL、10 mL、20 mL 三種規格的小瓶。在什麼條件下可以使用 Bracketing 只測試 2 mL 和 20 mL？如果容器密封 (Closure) 不同，還能用 Bracketing 嗎？
blocks.en: A filling line produces vials in three sizes: 2 mL, 10 mL and 20 mL. Under what conditions can bracketing be used to test only 2 mL and 20 mL? If the container closure differs, can bracketing still be used?

blocks.zh: 3.3 Worst-Case Scenarios 3.3 最差狀況情境
blocks.en: 3.3 Worst-Case Scenarios

blocks.zh: Worst-Case (最壞情境)：指的是在正常操作參數的允許範圍內，對產品無菌性構成最大風險的條件組合。重要的是，Worst-Case 不等於「異常情境」 — 設備故障、嚴重偏差等應作為 Deviation 處理，不應納入 APS 的 Worst-Case 設計。
blocks.en: Worst-Case: This refers to the combination of conditions, within the permitted range of normal operating parameters, that poses the greatest risk to product sterility. Importantly, worst case does not mean an "abnormal scenario": equipment failures, serious deviations and the like should be handled as deviations and should not be included in the APS worst-case design.

blocks.zh: 人員數量的雙面性：TR22 提出了一個反直覺的觀點：最多人員不一定是 Worst-Case。如果人數過少導致操作員需要過度移動或操作流程變得複雜，反而可能增加污染風險。關鍵在於評估「哪種人員配置會帶來最大的微生物污染風險」。
blocks.en: The two sides of personnel numbers: TR22 makes a counterintuitive point: the largest number of personnel is not necessarily the worst case. If too few people force operators to move excessively or make the workflow more complicated, the contamination risk may actually increase. The key is to evaluate "which staffing configuration poses the greatest risk of microbial contamination".

blocks.zh: Worst-Case 就像壓力測試一輛車：你要測試它在「最高允許速度」和「最大載重」下是否仍然安全。你不會測試輪胎爆胎時能否安全行駛 (那是事故情境，不是 Worst-Case)。同樣地，你也不會只在風和日麗的路上測試 — 你要選擇最具挑戰性的合法駕駛條件。
blocks.en: Worst case is like stress-testing a car: you test whether it is still safe at the "maximum permitted speed" and "maximum load". You would not test whether it can be driven safely with a blown tire (that is an accident scenario, not a worst case). Likewise, you would not test only on a sunny, windless day; you choose the most challenging legitimate driving conditions.

blocks.zh: 人員數量的邏輯就像餐廳廚房：太多人可能互相碰撞弄髒食物，但太少人可能導致一個廚師要同時顧好幾個鍋，反而更容易出錯。
blocks.en: The logic of personnel numbers is like a restaurant kitchen: too many people may bump into each other and soil the food, but too few may leave one cook watching several pots at once, which makes errors more likely.

blocks.zh: Worst-Case 必須有書面理由 (Justification)：這是法規稽查的常見查核點。不能簡單地說「我們選最多人」就算 Worst-Case，必須說明為何這個條件代表最高風險。
blocks.en: Worst-case selection must have a documented justification: This is a common inspection focus. It is not enough to say "we chose the maximum number of personnel" as the worst case; you must explain why this condition represents the highest risk.

blocks.zh: 充填速度的雙重邏輯：
blocks.en: The dual logic of filling speed:

blocks.zh: 最慢速度 + 最大容器：瓶口暴露在環境中的時間最長，微生物落入的機率最高
blocks.en: Slowest speed + largest container: the container opening is exposed to the environment for the longest time, so the probability of microbial ingress is highest

blocks.zh: 最快速度 + 最難操控的容器：機械操作可能不穩定，增加介入操作的風險
blocks.en: Fastest speed + most difficult-to-handle container: mechanical operation may become unstable, increasing the risk associated with interventions

blocks.zh: 這兩種情境代表不同類型的風險，需要根據實際製程特性選擇最相關的 Worst-Case。
blocks.en: These two scenarios represent different types of risk, and the most relevant worst case should be selected according to the actual characteristics of the process.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，Worst-Case 的選擇經常需要跨部門討論。建議組建包含生產、品保、工程和微生物學專家的團隊，使用風險評估工具 (如 FMEA) 系統性地識別和排序 Worst-Case 條件。評估結果應文件化，並在每次 Periodic APS 前重新審視 — 因為隨著生產經驗累積，對風險的理解可能會改變。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, selecting the worst case often requires cross-functional discussion. It is advisable to form a team that includes production, QA, engineering and microbiology experts, and to use risk assessment tools (such as FMEA) to systematically identify and rank worst-case conditions. The assessment results should be documented and reviewed again before each periodic APS, because understanding of the risks may change as production experience accumulates.

blocks.zh: 某工廠的無菌充填線在正常生產時有 4-6 名操作員。設計 APS 時應如何決定人員數量是 4 人還是 6 人為 Worst-Case？需要考慮哪些因素？
blocks.en: A site's aseptic filling line normally operates with 4 to 6 operators. When designing the APS, how should you decide whether 4 or 6 personnel is the worst case? What factors need to be considered?

blocks.zh: 如果風險評估顯示無法明確定義單一 Worst-Case 情境，TR22 建議怎麼辦？這對 APS 執行計畫有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If the risk assessment shows that a single worst-case scenario cannot be clearly defined, what does TR22 recommend? What impact does this have on the APS execution plan?

blocks.zh: 3.4 Risk Assessment for Aseptic Process Simulation Design 3.4 無菌製程模擬設計的風险評估
blocks.en: 3.4 Risk Assessment for Aseptic Process Simulation Design

blocks.zh: Risk Assessment for APS Design (APS 設計的風險評估)：風險評估不只是選擇 Worst-Case 的工具，更是確保 APS 設計「具代表性且適當」(representative and appropriate) 的核心方法論。它的輸出直接決定了 APS 的範圍、條件和成功標準。
blocks.en: Risk Assessment for APS Design: Risk assessment is not only a tool for selecting the worst case; it is the core methodology for ensuring that the APS design is "representative and appropriate". Its output directly determines the scope, conditions and acceptance criteria of the APS.

blocks.zh: Multifunctional Team (跨功能團隊)：TR22 強調 APS 的風險評估需要跨領域團隊，包括製程專家、設備工程師、設施設計師、微生物學家和品質人員。這反映了 APS 設計不是單一部門的工作，而是需要整合多方專業知識。
blocks.en: Multifunctional Team: TR22 emphasizes that the APS risk assessment requires a multidisciplinary team, including process experts, equipment engineers, facility designers, microbiologists and quality personnel. This reflects that APS design is not the work of a single department but requires the integration of expertise from many areas.

blocks.zh: Intervention 評估三要素：頻率 (Frequency)、與無菌物料/表面的接近程度 (Proximity)、持續時間 (Duration) — 這三個維度共同決定了每個介入操作的風險等級。
blocks.en: Three factors for evaluating interventions: frequency (Frequency), proximity to sterile materials/surfaces (Proximity), and duration (Duration). Together, these three dimensions determine the risk level of each intervention.

blocks.zh: 風險評估就像醫院的感染管控計畫 (Contamination Control Strategy, CCS)。在規劃手術室的感染控制措施時，你需要組建一個包含外科醫師、護理師、院感專家和設備工程師的團隊。每個人從自己的專業角度識別風險：外科醫師知道哪些手術步驟最容易暴露傷口，護理師知道器械傳遞的風險，院感專家知道環境微生物的來源，工程師知道空調系統的薄弱點。只有整合所有觀點，才能設計出真正有效的感染控制方案。
blocks.en: Risk assessment is like a hospital's infection control plan (the Contamination Control Strategy, CCS). When planning infection control measures for an operating room, you need to form a team of surgeons, nurses, infection control specialists and equipment engineers. Each person identifies risks from their own area of expertise: surgeons know which surgical steps expose the wound most, nurses know the risks of instrument handling, infection control specialists know the sources of environmental microorganisms, and engineers know the weak points of the air-conditioning system. Only by integrating all of these perspectives can you design an infection control program that is truly effective.

blocks.zh: APS 設計的五大關鍵問題：TR22 列出了五個風險評估必須回答的問題，這些問題本質上是在檢驗 APS 設計的「完整性」和「有效性」：
blocks.en: Five key questions for APS design: TR22 lists five questions that the risk assessment must answer. In essence, these questions test the "completeness" and "effectiveness" of the APS design:

blocks.zh: 代表性 (Representativeness)：APS 是否涵蓋了所有製程階段？特別注意某些操作（如惰性氣體使用、冷凍乾燥）可能「掩蓋」微生物污染
blocks.en: Representativeness: Does the APS cover all process stages? Pay particular attention to the fact that some operations (such as inert gas use and lyophilization) may "mask" microbial contamination

blocks.zh: 完整性 (Completeness)：是否模擬了完整的製造流程，包括物料傳遞和跨子製程的操作？
blocks.en: Completeness: Does it simulate the complete manufacturing process, including material transfer and operations across sub-processes?

blocks.zh: 挑戰性 (Challenge)：APS 是否能夠「挑戰」製程能力，而非只是走過場？
blocks.en: Challenge: Can the APS truly "challenge" process capability, rather than being a mere formality?

blocks.zh: 適當性 (Appropriateness)：Worst-Case 條件是否適當，既能代表風險又不會對 APS 本身造成不必要的風險？
blocks.en: Appropriateness: Are the worst-case conditions appropriate, representing the risk without creating unnecessary risk to the APS itself?

blocks.zh: 合規性 (Compliance)：設計是否符合法規和行業指南要求？
blocks.en: Compliance: Does the design meet regulatory and industry guidance requirements?

blocks.zh: 高層管理的角色 Senior Management Role
blocks.en: Senior Management Role

blocks.zh: TR22 特別強調高層管理對 APS 風險評估的「Sponsorship」（支持）。這不是空話 — 風險評估的結果可能需要額外的資源投入（如增加 APS 次數、改善設備、增加人員培訓）。沒有高層的支持，風險評估很容易流於形式，團隊可能傾向於「最小化」風險結論以避免增加工作量。這是 Quality Culture (品質文化) 的直接體現。
blocks.en: TR22 specifically emphasizes senior management "sponsorship" of the APS risk assessment. This is not empty talk: the results of a risk assessment may require additional resources (such as more APS runs, equipment improvements, or more personnel training). Without senior management support, the risk assessment easily becomes a formality, and the team may be inclined to "minimize" the risk conclusions to avoid extra workload. This is a direct expression of quality culture.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 中，APS 風險評估是一項高價值的品質活動。建議使用以下架構：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, the APS risk assessment is a high-value quality activity. The following framework is recommended:

blocks.zh: 流程圖分析：繪製完整的無菌製程流程圖，標記每個可能引入污染的步驟
blocks.en: Process flow analysis: draw a complete aseptic process flow diagram and mark each step that could introduce contamination

blocks.zh: Intervention 清單：列出所有預期和非預期的介入操作，並按頻率、接近度、持續時間評分
blocks.en: Intervention list: list all expected and unexpected interventions and score them by frequency, proximity and duration

blocks.zh: CCS 連結：將風險評估結果與 CCS 對照，確認每個已識別的風險都有相應的控制措施
blocks.en: CCS linkage: compare the risk assessment results against the CCS to confirm that every identified risk has a corresponding control measure

blocks.zh: APS 設計矩陣：將評估結果轉化為 APS 的具體設計參數（時間、速度、人員、介入操作等）
blocks.en: APS design matrix: translate the assessment results into specific APS design parameters (duration, speed, personnel, interventions, etc.)

blocks.zh: 在冷凍乾燥 (Lyophilization) 製程的 APS 中，為何「凍結培養基」可能是一個問題？如何在不妨礙微生物偵測的前提下模擬冷凍乾燥步驟？
blocks.en: In an APS for a lyophilization process, why might "freezing the growth medium" be a problem? How can the lyophilization step be simulated without hindering microbial detection?

blocks.zh: TR22 提到 APS 不應「掩蓋重要風險因素」。請舉一個例子，說明在 APS 中使用惰性氣體 (Inert Gas) 如何可能掩蓋污染風險，以及如何應對。
blocks.en: TR22 states that APS should not "mask important risk factors". Give an example of how using inert gas in an APS could mask contamination risk, and explain how to address it.

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO 的品質主管，如何向高層管理證明投入更多資源在 APS 風險評估上是值得的？你會用什麼數據或論述來說服他們？
blocks.en: If you were the quality head of a CDMO, how would you demonstrate to senior management that investing more resources in APS risk assessment is worthwhile? What data or arguments would you use to persuade them?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: APS 是整合性驗證：Aseptic Process Simulation (無菌製程模擬) 使用微生物培養基模擬完整製程，驗證設備、環境、人員操作與物料傳遞的整體無菌保證能力
blocks.en: APS is integrated validation: Aseptic Process Simulation uses microbiological growth medium to simulate the complete process and verifies the overall sterility assurance capability of equipment, environment, personnel operations and material transfer

blocks.zh: 先決條件缺一不可：設備確認、HVAC 驗證、滅菌確效、EM 計畫、人員培訓、SOP 等必須全部就緒後才能執行 APS；Engineering Batches / Water Trials 應在正式 APS 前完成
blocks.en: Every prerequisite is essential: Equipment qualification, HVAC validation, sterilization validation, the EM program, personnel training, SOPs and so on must all be in place before APS is performed; engineering batches / water trials should be completed before the formal APS

blocks.zh: 頻率與次數有明確要求：初始至少連續 3 批成功；定期再確認每半年一次（每線、每製程、每班次）；每位操作員每年至少參與一次成功 APS
blocks.en: Frequency and number have clear requirements: initially at least 3 consecutive successful runs; periodic requalification every six months (per line, per process, per shift); every operator takes part in at least one successful APS per year

blocks.zh: Worst-Case 需基於科學理由：不是簡單地選擇「最極端」條件，而是識別對無菌性構成最大風險的條件組合，且必須書面文件化其選擇理由
blocks.en: Worst case must rest on scientific rationale: it is not simply a matter of choosing the "most extreme" conditions, but of identifying the combination of conditions that poses the greatest risk to sterility, and the rationale for the selection must be documented

blocks.zh: 風險評估驅動 APS 設計：使用跨功能團隊，系統性評估製程風險，確保 APS 設計具代表性、完整性和挑戰性；評估結果應與 CCS 連結
blocks.en: Risk assessment drives APS design: use a cross-functional team to systematically assess process risks, ensuring that the APS design is representative, complete and challenging; the assessment results should be linked to the CCS

blocks.zh: Bracketing/Matrix 可降低負擔：對多規格容器可使用括弧法/矩陣法，但前提是製程等效且容器密封配置相同
blocks.en: Bracketing/matrix can reduce the burden: bracketing/matrix approaches can be used for multiple container formats, provided that the processes are equivalent and the container closure configuration is the same
